48457.summary: In 2026, Tyler's planning and zoning commission voted 5-2 to deny a special use permit for Vulcan Core's Bitcoin mining data center on West Erwin Street, citing incompatibility with nearby homes; residents objected to water use and noise. No organized group identified.

48459.name: Upshur County
48459.label: high
48459.summary: No local opposition reported in Upshur County. The only evidence is a site listing for one greenfield candidate, EC FFE Upshur County, in Upshur Rural Electric Coop territory; no groups, moratorium or official actions.

48461.name: Upton County
48461.label: high
48461.summary: No local opposition reported in Upton County. The only known project is Hut 8's 280 MW King Mountain campus near McCamey, a former Compute North bitcoin mine operating since 2022.

48463.name: Uvalde County
48463.label: high
48463.summary: AEP Texas celebrated the September 2025 groundbreaking of Rowan Digital Infrastructure's 300 MW, $900 million CINCO data center, expected to bring 600 construction jobs and 40 permanent jobs. No opposition or moratorium discussions are reported.

reasons.reason: existing approved Rowan project with utility support

48465.name: Val Verde County
48465.label: high
48465.summary: On July 15, 2026, Val Verde County commissioners voted 5-0 to refuse data center tax abatements and incentives. Residents objected at a Sept. 9 town hall to a possible 200-plus-acre site near Lausen Lane over the San Felipe Springs recharge zone; the Greater Edwards Aquifer Alliance opposes.

48467.name: Van Zandt County
48467.label: high
48467.summary: As of early November 2026, no data center has been announced in Van Zandt County, though GridCensus lists 17 candidate sites. The Commissioners Court adopted a Feb. 11, 2026 moratorium on battery storage, solar and wind projects, which does not name data centers.

reasons.reason: rural no-zoning distrust and 17 candidate sites
no organized group or announced project

48469.name: Victoria County
48469.label: medium
48469.summary: Concerned Citizens for Responsible Development has organized meetings since June 2026 against data centers and Blue Energy's tax abatements. Victoria City Council chose an August 2026 ordinance (500-ft setbacks, closed-loop cooling, 55 dB) over a moratorium, and commissioners accepted a builders' support letter in October.

48471.name: Walker County
48471.label: high
48471.summary: A TikTok video shows a packed Walker County annex as commissioners prepared to vote on a data center moratorium; the outcome and date are not stated. Cipher Digital's 500 MW, 187-acre Milsing site near Huntsville is listed as opposed on SueDataCenters.org.

48473.name: Waller County
48473.label: high
48473.summary: No local opposition recorded in Waller County. Tracker listings show the greenfield EC FFE Waller County site and Serverfarm's 565,000 sq ft HTX2 facility in Hockley, under construction from mid-2025 to mid-2026.

reasons.reason: no recorded local opposition or groups
existing data center built without controversy
ERCOT large-load pause and grid constraints

48475.name: Ward County
48475.label: high
48475.summary: No local opposition appears in 53 items. Ionic Digital's Barstow campus runs 234 MW, and ERCOT provisionally approved a 466 MW expansion in September 2026. Microsoft declined Nscale's expansion option in November 2026.

48477.name: Washington County
48477.label: high
48477.summary: On Jan. 8, 2026, Brenham City Council voted against a reinvestment zone and tax abatement for Viridien's 21-acre, up to 45 MW data center. Over 100 residents attended and a petition drew 1,000+ signatures; Viridien says it will proceed anyway.

48479.name: Webb County
48479.label: medium
48479.summary: Laredo officials asked Gov. Abbott for a statewide data center moratorium in July 2026; the council unanimously chose to draft regulations instead. A new 50M-gallon water deal bars data center use. Fronteras Sin Data Centers is pressing for transparency.

reasons.reason: county approved roads for data center site

48481.name: Wharton County
48481.label: high
48481.summary: A January 2026 Change.org petition, 'Protect Boling & Wharton County from Industrial Data Centers,' asked county officials for a moratorium. Amazon's $10B, 3,000-acre Project Eagle near Boling is under construction after the county judge signed an NDA. Unincorporated Wharton County has no zoning authority.

48483.name: Wheeler County
48483.label: medium
48483.summary: Wheeler County Judge Chalone Hefley publicly welcomes the Google workforce hub, and commissioners unanimously approved its sewer-facility plat on June 29, 2026. Opposition is limited to an outside group, SueDataCenters.org, with no local residents' group, petition or moratorium proposal.

reasons.reason: county leadership supports data center activity
emergency services and hospital strain concerns

48485.name: Wichita County
48485.label: high
48485.summary: Wichita Falls council unanimously rejected a 117-acre data center rezoning in May 2026 and tabled another; a statewide moratorium is in force since August. Mayor Short, reelected with 61%, backs Skybox's 225-acre campus, and planners approved a smaller DataNovaX site.

reasons.reason: recent council rejection and tabled rezoning

48487.name: Wilbarger County
48487.label: medium
48487.summary: County Judge Greg Tyra and Vernon Mayor Pam Gosline champion Google's Wilbarger County data center, which brings $4.5M for Vernon infrastructure. An October 2026 Change.org petition with 57 signatures seeks a pause over power bills, water and secrecy.

reasons.reason: county judge and mayor promote projects

48489.name: Willacy County
48489.label: medium
48489.summary: Willacy County Judge Aurelio Guerra champions Soluna's wind-powered Kati campus, which got a 15-year tax abatement, and reports little pushback. Opposition is limited to LUPE and the RGV Broadband coalition, while nearby Harlingen adopted a moratorium and Gov. Abbott froze state permits in September 2026.

reasons.reason: nearby moratoria and state permit freeze

48491.name: Williamson County
48491.label: medium
48491.summary: HALT Taylor gathered 1,400 signatures for a moratorium in June 2026; Zydeco withdrew its Hutto application in April. Taylor council still approved the 1 GW Taylor Technology Campus 5-0 on Oct 8, and Hutto approved Skybox 6-0.

reasons.reason: no county zoning authority / no moratorium adopted

48493.name: Wilson County
48493.label: high
48493.summary: Protect Wilson County Water and the Wilson County Resource Preservation Project gathered 2,500+ petition signatures and drew 150+ residents to meetings over Misae's 500 MW Stockdale project. A commissioner says the court lacks authority to stop data centers, and no moratorium exists.

48495.name: Winkler County
48495.label: high
48495.summary: No local opposition found in Winkler County: none of 31 items oppose and no groups are named. Cipher's 300 MW Black Pearl site near Wink, now under a 15-year AWS lease, delivered first capacity in August 2026; phase two is under construction.

48497.name: Wise County
48497.label: high
48497.summary: After a hearing drawing about 90 residents, Wise County commissioners unanimously asked the Legislature on March 9, 2026 to regulate data centers or empower counties. The county has no zoning power, and Decatur is drafting a data center overlay district, with a Nov. 4 hearing.

reasons.reason: no county zoning authority, permissive city overlay

48499.name: Wood County
48499.label: high
48499.summary: Predicted from regional evidence (0.77), 14 projects within 60 km and the county profile. No local sources yet.

48501.name: Yoakum County
48501.label: high
48501.summary: Predicted from regional evidence (0.72), 4 projects within 60 km and the county profile. No local sources yet.

48503.name: Young County
48503.label: medium
48503.summary: Graham City Council unanimously approved a 30-year development agreement with Headwaters/Stream for Project Saltworks on Oct. 29, 2026. Opposition led by Stop Graham Data Center led the developer to withdraw its county tax-abatement request on Oct. 13, 2026.

reasons.reason: organized local group forced abatement withdrawal

48505.name: Zapata County
48505.label: high
48505.summary: No local opposition recorded in Zapata County. The only local item is a GridCensus listing for a greenfield candidate site, EC FFE Zapata County, on land owned by Rancho San Antonio LLC, with a readiness score of 57.3/100.

reasons.reason: state moratoria trend (Fort Worth, Brownsville, Denton)

48507.name: Zavala County
48507.label: high
48507.summary: No local opposition reported in Zavala County. The only tracked project, Cipher Digital's 70 MW Cipher Reveille data center, has ERCOT interconnection approval and substation work underway toward a Q3 2027 target, with no signed tenant.
